title: Best tour in Granada
text:
Absolutely amazing Segway tour in Granada! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Fahres was an incredible guide , super friendly, knowledgeable, and made the whole experience fun and easy. He showed us beautiful spots we would have never found on our own and shared really interesting stories about the city.

The Segway was easy to handle, even for beginners, and the views were just breathtaking. Honestly one of the highlights of my time in Granada.
author: aureld537

title: My teens loved it!
text: I took my three teenagers on this ebike tour with guide Pedro, and it was one of the highlights of our weeks-long trip. Such a great way to get around and see the fascinating area and history from many different vantage points. Pedro made it interesting and fun. I liked it so much that the next day I came back and brought my 9-year-old- our tour guide was Nico, and he was also great at making it interesting for her age and fun. Highly recommend that you take the chance to get out and do this when in Granada.
author: amandatZ4133HB

title: Tour by Granada
